args: repo="${CODEX_COMPANION_REPO:-$HOME/dev/ai-companion-app}"; cd "$repo" 2>/dev/null || { echo "codex-companion not found at $repo" >&2; exit 1; }; exec uv run --quiet codex-companion mcp
codex-companion.note: Runs from a repo checkout. Defaults to $HOME/dev/ai-companion-app; set CODEX_COMPANION_REPO to override.
